mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the average 20d return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting central bank hawkishness and reducing equity risk appetite, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE < 3.5, or the mean 20d return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.45 million units signals strong housing demand and rising consumer confidence, which forecasts improved corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1450.0, or the average 60d return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and a rise in the unemployment rate signals a weakening manufacturing sector and labor market stress, indicating an impending recession that triggers risk-off behavior and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 690 billion dollars signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS < 690000, or the average 5d return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in CPI inflation above 3.0% combined with a stable federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressure that increases the risk of future rate hikes, leading to equity market repricing and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS <= 4.7, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200,000 jobs per month signals strong labor market momentum that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 155500, or the average 60d return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP growth below 2.0% annualized combined with rising housing starts signals a weakening economy and declining business investment, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 < 20200 and HOUST > 1450, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).
